text: Close-up of bare skin in natural window light, no filter, camera held close enough to see texture.
Hand sweeps a cluttered row of half-empty skincare bottles into the trash, then holds up just [product].
Split screen: day 1 on the left, today on the right, same lighting, same angle.
Creator walks into frame mid-eye-roll, holding [product] like it just personally offended them.
Extreme close-up of [product] doing something nobody expects, with no talking for the first two seconds.
Phone screen showing the comment, then a quick cut to the creator reacting to it in the mirror.
Creator pats a bare cheek and winces, or pulls the skin to show how tight or dry it looks.
Two people in a bathroom, one mid-skincare routine, the other already grabbing the product off the counter.
